# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** forty-five  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with a fresh, almost girlish face, pink cheeks that can deepen with a flush, sweet lips, and dimples. Her snow-white hair is thick, beautifully wavy, and carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. She has pretty hands and large, soft, wistful wood-brown eyes containing little golden glints.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P12](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0012), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis, named by her father after lavender, resided at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young assistant, Charlotta the Fourth. During a tea visit with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), she became quiet and worn upon hearing the name of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former fiancé, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), with whom she had broken an engagement twenty-five years earlier over a silly quarrel. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visited her and discussed her past romance, Miss Lavendar agreed to meet [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), forming a fond connection with the boy. Hearing of her lingering melancholy, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) had [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inquire if he might visit, and upon his arrival at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), he and Miss Lavendar reconciled. Following preparations at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss Lavendar married Stephen, and the newlyweds were seen off by their guests.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), +21 more_

## Quotes

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "About your age I think. He ought to be older because I dreamed him long before you were born. But I’ll never let him get any older than eleven or twelve; because if I did some day he might grow up altogether and then I’d lose him."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)

> "Those curtains have not worn as well as they should, considering the price I paid. Dear me, Charlotta has forgotten to dust the stair railing again. I really must speak to her about it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P58](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0058)

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets lost and stumbles upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they quickly bond as intimate kindred spirits over tea, candy-making, and conversation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) becomes a frequent guest, bringing young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) to visit and agreeing to stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) when Lavendar experiences melancholy moods. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also acts as a liaison between Lavendar and her past suitor, carrying messages and helping Lavendar prepare for his return.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +22 more_

- Friend of — intimate kindred spirits  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +2 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Miss Lavendar's young maid and companion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) assists with hosting guests and deeply cares for Lavendar's well-being, confiding her worries to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Lavendar suffers from melancholy. They share in key moments together, including watching and celebrating when Lavendar's romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is renewed.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +14 more_

- Commands — help and companion  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss Lavendar shared a romance and were engaged twenty-five years prior. After years apart, Stephen reaches out through [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ask if he may visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where he and Lavendar reunite and walk affectionately in the garden. The two ultimately reconcile and marry in a wonderful wedding ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), +12 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
